title: 6 不着调的监天司7 白游级
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：到了儒子阁，事情却与贺堪想的完全不一样。
贺堪一言难尽的看着面前的白胡子老头，后者笑呵呵的仿佛没有看见贺堪古怪的目光一般。
“所以就直接扔下我们不管了？”
贺堪无奈的说道，李司士刚把他们一群人带到儒子阁，一个山洞洞窟，迫不及待的就走了留下几个人面面相视。
也幸亏有人及时出来接，有男有女，他们叫着名字将几个新人带走了。
只剩下贺堪被一个白胡子老头看上去不着调的叫了过来。
“是啊。”
白胡子老头完全没有悔改的意思，笑眯眯的点头说道：“咱们儒子阁引导新人都是这样，你们啊，这次还挺赶巧的，司里面没有太多任务要出，人也够，足够你们一人一位引导者，换作是以前，他们都是一人对你们一批的。”
那你们还挺厉害的。
贺堪眉毛一跳。
白胡子老头摸了摸胡子，像是没看见贺堪心里的吐槽一般，依旧笑呵呵的开口道：“来，我给你介绍介绍。”
“其实这些你们看也行，功法儒子阁都有，基础的自己看看就行。”
白胡子老头十分不在意的说道。
“……”
贺堪听见这话皱眉了。
这跟他想象中的不一样，监天司这般大费周折才选了几个苗子，按道理讲，不说是重点培养也不会放任自由，可这位王老的话，这跟放养也差不多了。
贺堪刚准备开口想要询问具体原因，这些过于反常的事情一定要先问清楚，不能稀里糊涂，这是有关修炼的问题。
“等我说完，你的一切困惑就都知道了。”
白胡子老头也就是王老意味深长的说道，说话十分恰好的打断了贺堪的困惑。
贺堪不说话了。

“首先是诡物，关于诡物的由来，谁也不知道，谁也不清楚，书本与传下来的卷轴没有任何记载，甚至那些大能们也不清楚。”
白胡子老头微微一笑，开口慢慢的讲着，“它们就好像在世界诞生的时候就出现在这个世界上一样，占据了这个世界大部分资源，也将人生存的地盘划分成一块一块的域与城池。”
“诡物们唯一的共同点就是喜欢血食。”
“诡物有智慧吗？”
贺堪沉默半响，询问道，他想起了之前那只鱼形怪，也被邹平司称为鲛人的肉团，那个肉团吃血食的时候，可是从一开始的来者不拒到挑三拣四。
“看来你遇到过诡物，也对，毕竟你觉醒了天赋，应该是走观想诡物那一条道路了。”
王老了然，语气淡然的回答：“不清楚。”
贺堪猛得抬起头看向王老。
王老依旧重复道：“是的，不清楚，我们对于诡物的了解依旧很少，”
“不过根据监天司内部的记载，有的诡物的确拥有不亚于人类的智慧，这些甚至还能伪装成人混进人类城池进行捕猎。”
王老的话没有说太明白却也从侧面证明，诡物的智慧绝对不低。
content_en:
: When they arrived at Confucian Pavilion, things were completely different from what He Kan thought.
He Kan looked at the old man with a white beard in front of him without saying anything, and the latter smiled as if he didn't see He Kan's strange gaze.
"So you just left us alone?"
He Kan said helplessly. Li Sishi had just brought a group of them to Confucian Pavilion, a cave, and left impatiently, leaving a few people looking at each other.
Fortunately, someone came out to pick them up in time, both men and women. They called the newcomers by name and took them away.
Only He Kan was called over by an old man with a white beard who seemed to be indifferent.
"Yeah."
The old man with a white beard showed no intention of repenting. He nodded with a smile and said: "We in Confucian Pavilion guide newcomers like this. You guys, this time is quite lucky. There are not many tasks to be done in the department, and there are enough people, enough for each of you to have a leader. In the past, they would all work for you one by one."
Then you are pretty awesome.
He Kan's eyebrows jumped.
The white-bearded old man touched his beard, as if he didn't see He Kan's inner complaints, and still said with a smile: "Come, let me introduce you."
"Actually, you can take a look at these. The Kung Fu Confucian Pavilion has them. Just take a look at the basics yourself."
The old man with the white beard said very nonchalantly.
"..."
He Kan frowned when he heard this.
This was different from what he had imagined. Supervisor Tiansi had gone to such great lengths to select a few seedlings. Logically speaking, he would not let them go freely unless they were focused on training. But according to Mr. Wang, this was almost like free rein.
He Kan was just about to open his mouth and wanted to ask for the specific reasons. These abnormal things must be asked clearly first, and they cannot be confused. This is a question about cultivation.
"When I finish speaking, all your confusion will be clear."
The white-bearded old man, also known as Mr. Wang, said meaningfully, interrupting He Kan's confusion perfectly.
He Kan stopped talking.
"First of all, there are the strange things. No one knows the origin of the strange things. No one is clear about it. There is no record in the books or scrolls passed down. Even the powerful ones don't know."
The white-bearded old man smiled slightly and spoke slowly, "It's as if they appeared in this world when the world was born. They occupy most of the world's resources and divide the land of human existence into domains and cities."
"The only thing the monsters have in common is that they like blood food."
"Do weird things have intelligence?"
He Kan was silent for a while and asked. He remembered the fish-shaped monster from before, which Zoupingsi also called the shark-like meat ball. When that meat ball ate blood food, it went from being open to all comers to being picky.
"It seems that you have encountered strange objects, which is correct. After all, you have awakened your talent, so you should take the path of contemplating strange objects."
Mr. Wang understood and replied calmly: "I don't know."
He Kan suddenly raised his head and looked at Mr. Wang.
Mr. Wang still repeated: "Yes, I don't know. We still know very little about strange things."
"However, according to the internal records of Supervisor Tiansi, some monsters do have intelligence that is no less than that of humans. They can even disguise themselves as humans and sneak into human cities to hunt."
Mr. Wang's words were not too clear, but they also proved from the side that the intelligence of the strange things is definitely not low.
